stories.title: Validate NOSS Section Completeness Across All 20 CoCu Files
stories.description: Create Python script that checks all 20 CoCu markdown files in content/IT-020-{3,4,5}/ contain the 8 required NOSS sections: header table, setup context, key terms, contact hour distribution, hardware/software descriptions, common faults, assessment criteria, and references. Output JSON report showing per-CoCu section coverage and overall compliance percentage.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/validate_section_completeness.py reads all 20 CoCu files and checks for section headers using regex (##\s+Section\s+Name or similar pattern)
Output JSON file logs/section_completeness_report.json with structure: {cocu_file: {section: bool, coverage_pct: float}}
Script flags any missing sections and returns exit code 1 if any CoCu missing >1 section, 0 if all sections present in all 20 files

stories.title: Verify 30/70 Knowledge-Performance Learning Outcome Balance Across All CoCu Files
stories.description: Create Python script that parses learning outcome statements from all CoCu assessment sections, classifies each statement as Knowledge or Performance using regex and keyword matching, and validates target ratios (≥28% Knowledge, ≥65% Performance per CoCu). Generate HTML dashboard showing per-CoCu outcome distribution with color-coded status.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/validate_learning_outcomes.py parses assessment sections and uses keyword matching (knows, understands, identifies → Knowledge; performs, operates, demonstrates, troubleshoots → Performance)
Output HTML file reports/learning_outcome_dashboard.html with per-CoCu pie charts showing % Knowledge vs % Performance
Report flags CoCu files that fall below targets and suggests rebalancing for non-compliant files

stories.title: Auto-Extract and Validate Bilingual Glossary from All Key Terms Tables
stories.description: Create Python script that extracts all English-Bahasa Malaysia key term pairs from the 'Key terms / tools' tables across all 20 CoCu files, generates unified glossary file sorted alphabetically, validates zero duplicate English terms, and checks BM spelling using PyDictionary. Output comprehensive glossary markdown and validation report.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/extract_bilingual_glossary.py parses markdown tables from all 20 CoCu files and extracts (English, Bahasa Malaysia) term pairs
Output file content/IT-020-shared/glossary_EN_BM.md containing 500+ terms alphabetically sorted with no duplicate English entries
Script validates BM spelling and flags suspicious terms for manual review in logs/glossary_spelling_issues.txt

stories.title: Validate Equipment and Technology Currency Against 2024-2026 Industry Standards
stories.description: Create script checking hardware/software/OS items listed in component tables against current market standards (CPU architectures, OS versions, database engines, programming languages). Flag items that are >3 years old or deprecated, suggest modern replacements, generate CSV report for content team review.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/validate_equipment_currency.py parses hardware/software tables from all 20 CoCu files and matches against reference data
Output CSV file logs/equipment_currency_report.csv with columns: CoCu_file, Item, Current_Year, Status (Current/Aging/Deprecated), Suggested_Replacement
Report flags any items released before 2021 as 'Aging' and suggests 2024+ equivalents for modernization

stories.title: Generate Interactive NOSS Compliance Dashboard (HTML/JSON)
stories.description: Create Python script that aggregates compliance data from all validation scripts (section completeness, learning outcome balance, contact hours, equipment currency, bilingual coverage) and generates interactive HTML5 dashboard showing overall compliance score (0-10) with breakdown by 5 compliance dimensions. Color-coded per-CoCu status indicators.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/generate_compliance_dashboard.py consumes JSON reports from validate_section_completeness.py, validate_learning_outcomes.py, and equipment_currency.py

Output HTML file reports/compliance_dashboard.html with: overall compliance score, 5-dimension breakdown (Section Completeness 20%, Learning Outcomes 20%, Contact Hours 20%, Bilingual Coverage 20%, Equipment Currency 20%), per-CoCu color status grid (green/yellow/red)
Dashboard updates in real-time when source JSON files change, suitable for JPK submission readiness tracking

stories.title: Validate Level Progression Logic (L3→L4→L5 Content Advancement)
stories.description: Create script that validates learning progression across qualification levels: L3 CoCu topics establish foundations, L4 builds on L3 with increased complexity/specialization, L5 adds management/strategic overlay. Check that each L4/L5 CoCu references corresponding L3 concepts, and content complexity increases appropriately. Output progression score per CoCu.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/validate_level_progression.py compares topic keywords and learning outcomes across L3/L4/L5 CoCu files with similar names (e.g., all 'Computer System Set-up' CoCu across levels)
Output JSON report logs/level_progression_report.json showing per-CoCu progression_score (0-10) and identified missing prerequisite links or complexity gaps
Flags L4/L5 CoCu that don't reference or build upon corresponding L3 content

stories.title: Generate Competency-Based Assessment Rubrics in JSON Schema
stories.description: Create Python script that generates standardized 4-point competency rubrics (1=Novice, 2=Developing, 3=Proficient, 4=Advanced) for each work activity in all 20 CoCu files. Output JSON schema per level (L3/L4/L5) with descriptor statements that align to Knowledge (30%) / Performance (70%) learning outcome split.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/generate_competency_rubrics.py reads assessment sections from all CoCu files and generates 4-point rubric definitions

Output JSON files output/rubrics_IT020_L3.json, output/rubrics_IT020_L4.json, output/rubrics_IT020_L5.json with structure: {work_activity: {level_1: {descriptor}, level_2: {descriptor}, level_3: {descriptor}, level_4: {descriptor}}}
Each rubric descriptor explicitly references Knowledge or Performance component (e.g., 'Demonstrates (Performance) understanding (Knowledge) of X')

stories.title: Validate Bahasa Malaysia Terminology Consistency and Spelling Across All CoCu Files
stories.description: Create script that validates Bahasa Malaysia terminology in bilingual header tables and key terms sections for consistency (same activity should have same BM translation across all CoCu files) and spelling accuracy. Flag inconsistencies, suggest standardized terminology, output corrections CSV.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/validate_bm_consistency.py extracts all BM terms from bilingual header tables and key terms tables across all 20 CoCu files
Output CSV file logs/bm_terminology_report.csv with columns: English_Term, BM_Translation, Occurrence_Count, Status (Consistent/Inconsistent), Suggested_Standard
Script flags any BM term that appears with 2+ different spellings/translations and recommends single standard form

stories.title: Auto-Generate Contact Hour Justification Documents per CoCu
stories.description: Create Python script that generates human-readable justification documents explaining how contact hour allocations in each CoCu align with NOSS guidelines. For each CoCu, output markdown file with per-activity hour breakdown, Knowledge/Performance ratio alignment, and pedagogical rationale. Place outputs in content/IT-020-{3,4,5}/.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/generate_contact_hour_justifications.py parses contact hour distribution tables from all 20 CoCu files

Output markdown files content/IT-020-3/contact_hour_justifications_L3.md, content/IT-020-4/contact_hour_justifications_L4.md, content/IT-020-5/contact_hour_justifications_L5.md with per-CoCu breakdown
Each justification includes: total hours, per-activity breakdown, Knowledge % vs Performance %, alignment statement to NOSS guidelines

stories.title: Generate NOSS Compliance Metadata Package for JPK Submission
stories.description: Create Python script that extracts all required NOSS metadata from 20 CoCu files (unit code, title EN/BM, contact hours, learning outcomes count, assessment methods, equipment list, references count) and generates JSON submission package validated against JPK requirements. Output ready for MySkills Portal upload.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/generate_noss_metadata.py parses all 20 CoCu files and extracts structured metadata fields

Output JSON file output/noss_compliance_metadata.json with structure: {unit_code: {title_en, title_bm, contact_hours, learning_outcomes_count, assessment_methods: [], equipment_list: [], references_count, validation_status}}
Script validates that all required JPK fields are present and properly formatted, returns exit code 0 only if metadata_validation_score >= 9.5/10
